name: Import MDD
description: Detect Mermaid diagram domains, ensure each is imported as a WebGME library, then invoke diagram-specific ImportMermaid plugins.

configStructure.name: mermaidSource
configStructure.description: One or more Mermaid diagrams. Separate multiple diagrams with a line containing only ---.
configStructure.value:
flowchart TD
  A[Start] --> B[End]
---
sequenceDiagram
  A->>B: hello

configStructure.name: ensureLibraries
configStructure.description: If true, import missing Mermaid domain libraries before invoking diagram importers.

configStructure.name: invokeDiagramImporters
configStructure.description: If true, call each required domain's ImportMermaid via invokePlugin.

configStructure.name: diagramTypeOverride
configStructure.description: Comma-separated diagram ids (e.g. flowchart,sequence). When set, skip auto-detect and use these domains.
